changes.title: Blue Rhapsody
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.before:
Colour: Pale Ice Blue shirt and dupatta, paired with Midnight Navy Dhaka pants,

Blue Rhapsody  brings together delicate ice blue and rich midnight navy in an elegant three-piece ensemble. The embroidered net shirt features intricate floral and trailing vine motifs, embellished with pearls, sequins and cut-glass beads. Attached Italian shimmer adds a soft sheen beneath the net, while an embellished neckline, decorative hem and delicate beaded sleeve edges complete the shirt.

Flowing midnight navy Dhaka pants create a striking contrast, with fine gota detailing tracing the panels. An airy ice blue net dupatta completes the look, adorned with pearls, sequins, cut-glass beads and crystal detailing, framed by an intricately embellished border. A graceful choice for weddings, festive gatherings and evening celebrations.

Details 
Model size Small
Shirt length 28.5 inches 
Dhaka Pant Length 45 inches

changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.before:
Colour: Dusty Lilac shirt and dupatta paired with Deep Aubergine Purple Dhaka pants, finished with silver, pink and mauve accents.

Lilac Muse pairs soft dusty lilac with deep aubergine purple in an elegant three-piece ensemble. The embroidered net shirt features delicate floral vines and cascading motifs, enriched with pearls, sequins and cut-glass beads in silver, pink and mauve tones. Attached Italian shimmer lends a subtle sheen beneath the embroidery, while a decorative neckline, pointed embroidered hem and crystal-drop sleeve detailing complete the design.

The flowing Dhaka pants feature fine gota detailing along the panels, adding definition to their generous silhouette. A matching dusty lilac net dupatta completes the ensemble with scattered floral motifs, pearls, sequins and cut-glass beads, framed by an embellished zigzag border and delicate crystal-drop edging. A graceful choice for wedding festivities and evening occasions.
